snippet.title: Traffic Architect -  Official Trailer | Road Building & Traffic Management Sim
snippet.description:
OUT NOV 3 ON STEAM

Wishlist Traffic Architect on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5028050/Traffic_Architect/

Traffic Architect is a 3D road-building and traffic-management game where the city is the easy part - keeping it moving isn't.

Design the road network for a growing city: 10 road tiers from gravel to multi-lane highways, bridges, tunnels, multi-level interchanges, per-phase traffic lights, buses, trains, metro and freight. Every car is simulated - and the congestion heatmap shows exactly where you planned badly.

Discord: https://discord.gg/mra874Wh7w
X: https://x.com/TrafficArch


#trafficarchitect #citybuilder #trafficsimulator #indiegame
